summary: Tested Petito Plus admin-only test tool and reordered help box. Backend: all 7 admin-endpoint regression tests PASS (admin activate/deactivate 200, non-admin 403, is_admin in /status). Frontend: admin sees plus-admin-tool + plus-admin-activate, tapping activates Plus and navigates to /universo?plus=success; active-state deactivate button restores inactive state. Normal user does NOT see admin tool. Help box plus-pay-help leads with self-payment reason (idx 83) before email mismatch (idx 218). Retry button dismisses. Regression: email prefilled with user email, invalid-email toast appears, both plan cards (annual/monthly) render.
critical_code_review_comments: Plus.jsx mixes admin UI with normal subscribe flow; consider extracting <AdminPlusToolBlock/> for readability.
In adminActivate error path, setBusy(false) is only reached on error (success does nav away) — fine, but adminDeactivate uses finally correctly; prefer consistent try/finally in both handlers.
